poc/Cargo.toml.approved:
[package]
name = "loki-poc"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false

# One Zakura family serves transaction construction, proving, scanning and FROST.
[dependencies]
orchard            = { package = "zakura-orchard", version = "=2.2.0" }
zcash_primitives   = { package = "zakura-primitives", version = "=2.2.0" }
pczt               = { package = "zakura-pczt", version = "=0.1.0-rc4", features = ["orchard", "signer", "io-finalizer", "prover", "spend-finalizer", "tx-extractor", "zcp-builder"] }
reddsa_frost       = { package = "zakura-reddsa", version = "=2.2.0", features = ["frost"] }
frost-core         = { version = "=3.0.0", features = ["serialization"] }
frost-rerandomized = { version = "=3.0.0", features = ["serialization"] }
pasta_curves       = { package = "zakura-pasta-curves", version = "=2.2.0" }
group              = "0.14"
incrementalmerkletree = "0.8.2"
ff                 = "0.14"
rand_core          = { version = "0.6", features = ["getrandom"] }
# Transactions use rand_core 0.10; FROST 3.0.0 keeps its public 0.6 RNG API.
rand_core_zp       = { package = "rand_core", version = "0.10" }
rand_zp            = { package = "rand", version = "0.10" }
# Deterministic nonce derivation for the Phase A binding tests. Test-only: a seeded
# stream stands in for the OS RNG so a publication is reproducible.
rand_chacha        = "0.3"
blake2b_simd       = "1"
blake3             = "1.8"
zeroize            = "1"
bip39              = { version = "2.2.2", default-features = false, features = ["std", "zeroize"] }
zip32              = "=0.2.1"
# At-rest encryption for member secrets (`MemberDir::write_sealed`). XChaCha20-Poly1305
# is already in the graph via zcash_note_encryption, so only the KDF is new: Argon2id is
# the one memory-hard password hash in wide review, and a passphrase needs a real KDF.
# `default-features = false` keeps it to the raw `hash_password_into` entry point.
chacha20poly1305   = "=0.10.1"
argon2             = { version = "0.5", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] }
ed25519-dalek      = { version = "2.2", features = ["rand_core"] }
x25519-dalek       = { version = "2.0", features = ["static_secrets"] }
hex                = "0.4"
ciborium           = "0.2"
serde_json         = "1"
zcash_address = { package = "zakura-address", version = "=2.2.0" }
zcash_protocol = { package = "zakura-protocol", version = "=2.2.0" }
zcash_note_encryption = "0.4.2"
# Only for the forbidden-pool tamper fixtures: these build a transparent / Sapling
# PCZT component directly through the public `pczt::parse` constructors, which is the
# only way to produce one (DeferredPcztBuilder has no transparent or Sapling methods).
zcash_transparent = { package = "zakura-transparent", version = "=2.2.0" }
sapling-crypto = { package = "zakura-sapling-crypto", version = "=2.2.0" }
ciborium-io        = "0.2"

[features]
# Compile probes that reproduce the two blocked checkpoint-1 requirements.
# Each FAILS TO COMPILE on purpose; the compiler error is the blocker report.
probe-zip2005 = []
setup-fault-injection = ["relay-communication"]
relay-communication = ["dep:loki-relay-client", "dep:loki-relay-protocol"]

# Caller-supplied alpha is threaded into the spend before rk is derived.
[patch.crates-io]
bip32 = { path = "vendor/bip32-0.6.0-pre.1" }
zakura-orchard = { path = "vendor/zakura-orchard" }
zakura-primitives = { path = "vendor/zakura-primitives" }

[dependencies.loki-relay-client]
path = "../communication/client"
optional = true

[dependencies.loki-relay-protocol]
path = "../communication/protocol"
optional = true

[[bin]]
name = "loki_relay_member"
path = "src/bin/loki_relay_member.rs"
required-features = ["relay-communication"]

[dependencies.sha2]
version = "=0.10.9"

purpose: Hosted setup admission and verified TLS; historical source hashes remain mandatory
